    • checkLine

      private boolean checkLine(int x, int y)
      Checks whether the piece just placed at (x, y) completes a line of K pieces. Only the four lines through that cell (row, column and both diagonals) can have been completed, so only those are examined, each one in both directions.
      Parameters:
      x - the column of the cell just played
      y - the row of the cell just played
      Returns:
      true if the player who just moved has a line

    • countLine

      private int countLine(int x, int y, int dx, int dy, Ilayout.ID player)
      Counts the consecutive cells of player found by walking from (x, y), without counting that cell, in the direction (dx, dy) until the board ends or another cell appears.
      Parameters:
      x - the column where the walk starts
      y - the row where the walk starts
      dx - the step in columns
      dy - the step in rows
      player - the player whose cells are counted
      Returns:
      the number of consecutive cells of player
